Variants.Content: Brightwater is located in the south-central part of the Reach. It is the ancestral castle of the Florentine family and is located within the road network between Highgarden, Oldtown and the Dorne Marches. It legally belongs to the Reach in the Seven Kingdoms; the Florent family is proud of the blood of the Gardener King, so this city is not only the center of the local territory, but also the most important foundation for them to dispute family status with the Tyrell family.

Entry Brightwater Keep If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

The craftsmen use their hands to measure the stone walls, wooden beams, iron doors, tombs and seams left by generations of repairs in Brightwater City. The priests use rituals to continue the common memory of the Seven Gods, the legacy of Rhoynar and the different bloodlines under the prince's rule. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Brightwater Keep They care about wells and springs, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and routes to avoid the scorching sun. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
